abstract_contract.input: ordered verified Initial IR module plus policy version 1
abstract_contract.output: ordered normalized Initial IR module or deterministic error
required_context: ordered functions, parameters, blocks and instructions
abstract_contract.scope: module-level entry with function-local value-use/ownership state; nominal type classification requires module structs

cfg_and_exceptions.pseudo_instruction_expansion: never creates/removes/splits blocks or edges and never changes a terminator or exceptional target
cfg_and_exceptions.all_blocks: pseudo-instructions are expanded in normal, exceptional, cleanup, continuation, and unreachable blocks alike
cfg_and_exceptions.constructor_repair: the production lifecycle pass separately rewrites owning constructor invokes: each gets a unique exceptional cleanup trampoline containing catch_entry, release(receiver), propagate; an owning struct receiver also gets release(receiver) prepended to its normal continuation; owning class receivers do not
cfg_and_exceptions.constructor_order: scan input blocks and instructions in order; cleanup names use the least constructor.receiver.cleanupN not colliding with an input block; normal releases are prepended in invoke encounter order; cleanup blocks are appended in encounter order

module_input: struct definitions for recursive nominal traits
implementation_dependency_graph: expanded function -> constructor invoke ownership repair

deterministic_errors.legal_input: Rust-authoritatively verified Initial IR makes all six pseudo-expansions total
deterministic_errors.policy_version: LifecycleNormalizationPolicyError: Unsupported lifecycle normalization policy version <repr>; expected 1
deterministic_errors.invalid_internal_type_state: ValueError using the stable messages defined by type_traits.errors
deterministic_errors.mixed_domain: policy error: input containing a lifecycle pseudo-instruction and an internal ownership helper is neither legal unnormalized nor normalized IR

owned_non_interface: retain(source) unless source is an owned temporary, in which case consume that ownership
IRAssign.aliasing: acquire replacement before loading/releasing old value, so self-assignment is safe

owned_non_interface: retain(source) unless source is an owned temporary, in which case consume that ownership

defaults.enum: const first declared variant with ordinal/payload zero
defaults.struct: defaults in declared field order then struct_new

IRMoveInit.source_reset: append default_value(source.type), store(source,default) iff needs_destroy and supports_default; otherwise no source store

IRRelocate.count: verified positive count is semantically validated before normalization but does not multiply the one typed storage value and emits no operand

idempotence.domain: single-pass only: verified pre-normalization Initial IR containing no internal retain, release, or interface_copy_owned helper; output is normalized Initial IR and is not generally a legal input
idempotence.rule: normalization is intentionally not idempotent because it also processes ordinary ownership-producing/consuming instructions; a second pass can change helper-free normalized functions
idempotence.production_sentinel: an input module containing retain, release, or interface_copy_owned is returned by identity; this compatibility shortcut is not a proof that every normalized helper-free module is a fixed point

metadata.generated: generated loads/stores/constants/calls/aggregate operations have no source_location; they carry exact operand/result types and operation-specific metadata stated in expansions
metadata.preserved_module_function_block: module struct order, function order, function name/parameters/return_type/may_throw, block order/name and all non-rewritten instruction fields are preserved
metadata.pseudo_source_location: consumed and not copied because normalized operations have no normative source-location attribution
metadata.return_transfer: IRReturn.transferred_storage is removed after its verified ownership obligation is discharged; trailing return-slot store/load may be folded without changing the returned value
metadata.unrelated: aggregate shape, field index/name, class/interface witness data, erased layout, types and all metadata on copied ordinary instructions are unchanged

ordering.adjacent: expand each completely before the next instruction
ordering.generated_names: per function, collect parameter and every recursively occurring IRValue name; start at max numeric name + 1 or zero; allocate the next unused decimal integer monotonically
ordering.module: functions in input order; structs retained in input order
ordering.terminators: verified pseudo-instructions occur before a block terminator and expansions remain at that position
ordering.traversal: function order, then input block order including unreachable blocks, then instruction order
ordering.unordered_containers: sets/counters affect membership only; no iteration order is emitted

ownership_state.owned_temporary_definition: results needing destruction from calls, indirect/interface calls, string concatenation, non-borrowed collection extraction, collection construction/copy/slice, struct new/set, method-result new, class new, interface construct, and class get
ownership_state.copy_or_assign: an owned source temporary transfers its one ownership into destination; otherwise copy retains or uses interface_copy_owned
ownership_state.destroy: release exactly once only for needs_destroy types
ownership_state.move_relocate: bitwise typed transfer; source lifetime was consumed by verification; move resets destructible defaultable storage to a valid empty value solely for later concrete storage safety; relocate does not reset
ownership_state.transferred_storage: verified return exempts exactly the named live owner; normalization discharges it via preceding move/copy/cleanup, strips the marker, and may fold the return-slot store/load
ownership_state.whole_function: owned-result and use census is derived from the complete ordered function; no external mutable state or whole-program analysis

type_traits.Nullable: trivially_copyable follows inner; relocatable true; needs_destroy follows inner; supports_default true
type_traits.Struct_MethodResult: recursive conjunction of copyable/relocatable/default and disjunction of needs_destroy in declared field order
type_traits.Vector: trivial copy/relocate/no destroy; default only for row or column orientation
